summary: Frontend-only iteration 32 (Expo web preview). Verified BOTH reported bug fixes for provtest@jobby.app: (1) Provider activity subcategory 'Configura' rows visible and functional; (2) 401 no-crash + login-redirect. Zero page errors, zero LogBox red screen, no uncaught 'unauthorized' text. Token is cleared and app routes to /onboarding as designed. Only pre-existing deprecation console warnings observed (shadow* and props.pointerEvents in RN-web); not regressions.

react_native_issues.issue: React-Native-Web deprecation warning: 'shadow*' style props are deprecated, use 'boxShadow' (repeated in console). Not blocking, but should migrate for future RN-web releases. Reference: /app/frontend/src/theme.ts (shadow tokens).
React-Native-Web deprecation: props.pointerEvents is deprecated; use style.pointerEvents. Non-blocking. Reference: any component using pointerEvents prop directly.

action_items: (Optional cleanup) Migrate shadow* style props to boxShadow across theme.ts to silence RN-Web deprecation warnings.
(Optional cleanup) Replace pointerEvents prop with style.pointerEvents to silence RN-Web deprecation warning.
critical_code_review_comments: api.ts: 401 handler correctly clears token, invokes unauthorizedHandler and throws 'unauthorized'. Verified via corrupt-token test.
AuthContext.tsx: Registers/unregisters unauthorizedHandler and does router.replace('/onboarding') on 401. Confirmed working.

payments-settings.tsx: saveCard/saveBank/saveCrypto correctly swallow 'unauthorized' error (only Alert on other errors). No uncaught propagation. useFocusEffect(load) also benefits from global handler.

activities.tsx: SUBCONFIG map correctly renders configure-artigiani and configure-driver rows only when the corresponding cat_id is selected in `selected` state. Routes to /artigiani/listino and /driver/listino verified live.
seed_data_creation: None. Used existing provtest@jobby.app / test1234 (services: artigiani, driver, pulizie).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Both bug fixes are working live on Expo web at https://jobby-mvp-update.preview.emergentagent.com. E2E flow tested: login → Profilo → Le mie attività → configure-artigiani → /artigiani/listino (mestieri chips + al-mest-* testIDs visible); back to activities → configure-driver → /driver/listino (dl-tipo-ncc + dl-tipo-taxi visible). Separately: after corrupting jobby_session_token in localStorage to '"bad-token-xyz"' then Aggiungi carta → Salva, app redirected to /onboarding without any Uncaught red-screen; localStorage token cleared. Login screen renders Accedi/Registrati.
rca_of_issue: n/a — both fixes verified. Prior red-screen was caused by uncaught throw 'unauthorized' from api.request; now (a) global handler in AuthContext clears session & routes to onboarding, and (b) save* handlers swallow the 'unauthorized' error string in payments-settings.tsx so nothing bubbles up to LogBox.
